caseName: St. Peter's Roman Catholic Parish v. Urban Redevelopment Authority
caseNameFull: ST. PETER’S ROMAN CATHOLIC PARISH v. URBAN REDEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF PITTSBURGH Et Al.
attorneys: Louis C. Glasso for appellant., Theodore L. Hazlett, Jr. and R. J. Hopkins for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
